name: Environmentally Preferable Purchasing FY15 - Construction
description:
This dataset lists New York City construction-related contracts registered in fiscal year 2015 that were reviewed under the city's Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) program. Each row represents one contract and includes the awarding agency (such as DPR, DHS, NYPD, DCAS, or DSNY), a short description of the work (for example roof replacement, general construction, or facility rehabilitation), the contract registration date, the EPP product type involved (such as Energy Star products, architectural coatings, carpet and adhesives, roof coatings, or faucets and showerheads), whether the products met EPP minimum standards (Yes or No), and the contract value in dollars.

The data can be used to analyze how often construction contracts comply with environmental purchasing standards, which agencies and product categories account for the most EPP activity, and how contract size relates to compliance. It is useful for procurement oversight, sustainability reporting, and identifying product types or agencies where EPP standards are
